name: 34-hono-except-async-conditions
title: Allow async condition functions in combine middleware
body: Widen the Condition type to allow returning a Promise<boolean>, so conditions can do async lookups (e.g. checking an allowlist store). except() now evaluates its conditions in order and stops at the first match.

bugs.why: cond(c) is not awaited, so an async condition returns a Promise that is always truthy and except() skips the wrapped middleware (e.g. auth) for every request.
